title: Sunflower Girl Whip Poses
description: Four sequential panels of a stylized anime girl with sunflower-themed accessories performing dynamic poses with a long black whip. She wears a yellow and black outfit with corset, shorts, boots, and fingerless gloves against a solid lime green background.
prompt: A four-panel sequence on a solid lime green background showing the same anime girl with short black hair, sunflower hair accessories, and a fierce expression. She wears a yellow and black battle outfit with corset, frilled skirt, thigh straps, and heavy boots. In each panel she strikes a different dynamic action pose cracking a long black whip with sunflower details at the tip, various motion lines and flower petals flying around her.
